cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Test the Impossible Claim
cards.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. This tap gives you whatever you ask for. Ask for tea while I hold a cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not using my good china for that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'll hold a saucepan. You ask.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask, but I'm not tasting anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for a biscuit instead. If one comes out, we won't need your tongue as equipment.

mechanism: A supervises experimental design while negotiating changes that still leave B taking the first step to test a request-responsive tap.
confusable: D149 assigns the impossible task itself; D152 asks B for an ordinary first act that could demonstrate a bizarre claim.
comparison: A harmless request test with china and tasting concerns differs from probing a claimed invisible bridge.
seedUse: Keep B's protection of crockery and refusal to taste as useful constraints, not incompetence.
